title: Chile Telescope Finds Alien Signal

scenes.text: Chile's 39‑meter ELT spots a potential alien biosignature
scenes.query: Extremely Large Telescope Chile night sky

scenes.text: The ELT can collect 15 times more light than current 8‑meter telescopes
scenes.label: 15X MORE LIGHT

scenes.text: It captured a faint infrared line that matches phosphine, a potential biosignature gas
scenes.label: PHOSPHINE LINE DETECTE

scenes.text: The target planet orbits a red dwarf 40 light‑years away, inside its habitable zone
scenes.label: PLANET IN HABITABLE ZO

scenes.text: Follow for daily science that blows your mind.

description: The European Southern Observatory's ELT has just recorded a possible biosignature on a nearby world. Could this be the first hint of life beyond Earth? Follow for daily science!
